kebab_example: aliyun sls create-source-model --project my-project --biz-language zh_cn --logstores order-log --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSourceModel

parameters.help_en: The name of the project. The model belongs to the project, and each project corresponds to one model
parameters.help_zh: Project 名称。模型归属于该 Project，一个 Project 对应一个模型
parameters.name: project

parameters.help_en: The language used to generate the model. Valid values: zh_cn (Simplified Chinese) and en_us (English). Default value: zh_cn. This setting is not saved. If you do not specify this parameter when regenerating the model, the value falls back to zh_cn
parameters.help_zh: 生成模型时使用的语言，取值 zh_cn（简体中文）或 en_us（英文）；不传时默认 zh_cn。该设置不会被保存，重新生成时若不传则回落为 zh_cn
parameters.name: language

parameters.help_en: The list of Logstore names involved in the modeling task. If you omit this parameter or pass an empty array, all Logstores in the project are used for modeling
parameters.help_zh: 参与建模的 Logstore 名称列表。省略或传空数组表示对该 Project 下的全部 Logstore 建模
parameters.name: logstores

schema.description_en: The response body indicating that the modeling request has been accepted
schema.description_zh: 响应体。表示建模请求已被受理

status.description_en: The status of the call result. If the request is accepted, success is returned. Modeling is an asynchronous process. A success response only indicates that the task has been submitted. To check whether the model is ready, call GetSourceModelStatus
status.description_zh: 调用结果状态。受理成功时固定返回 success。建模是异步过程，返回 success 仅表示任务已提交，模型就绪请调用 GetSourceModelStatus 确认

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The request body. You can omit this parameter or specify only the scope and language for the current modeling task
v1_body_parameters.help_zh: 请求体。可省略，也可以只设置本次建模的范围与语言
v1_body_parameters.name: body
